name: Telecom Services Line Item 4
definition: Telecom services line item carries detail level telephony billing data.

StartDateTime.name: Start Date Time
StartDateTime.definition: Contains the start date and time of the phone call.

TimePeriod.name: Time Period
TimePeriod.definition: Describes the period (such as peak or off peak) of the phone call.

Duration.name: Duration
Duration.definition: Duration of phone call expressed in HHMMSS format.

CallFromType.name: Call From Type
CallFromType.definition: Contains call type values for the originator of the telephone call . P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

CallFromCity.name: Call From City
CallFromCity.definition: City from which the call was made.

CallFromCountrySubDivisionMajor.name: Call From Country Sub Division Major
CallFromCountrySubDivisionMajor.definition: Country sub division major from which the call was made.

CallFromCountrySubDivisionMinor.name: Call From Country Sub Division Minor
CallFromCountrySubDivisionMinor.definition: Country sub division minor from which the call was made.

CallFromCountry.name: Call From Country
CallFromCountry.definition: Country from which  the call was made.

CallToType.name: Call To Type
CallToType.definition: Contains call type values for the destination of the telephone call .

CallToCity.name: Call To City
CallToCity.definition: City to which the call was made.

CallToCountrySubDivisionMajor.name: Call To Country Sub Division Major
CallToCountrySubDivisionMajor.definition: Country sub division major to which the call was made.

CallToCountrySubDivisionMinor.name: Call To Country Sub Division Minor
CallToCountrySubDivisionMinor.definition: Country sub division minor to which the call was made.

CallToCountry.name: Call To Country
CallToCountry.definition: Country to which  the call was made.

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.definition: Contains the amount pertaining to the telephony billing event.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Total of taxes applicable to the billing amount of the telephone call.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Total amount includes amounts of all charge types and total tax amounts.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Description of the telecommunications services line item details

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
